title: A glossary from a loop
brief:
You have a list of three words from this unit. Use a for loop to ask the AI to define each one in one simple sentence, and print the definitions as a numbered glossary:

```
1. variable: ...
2. server: ...
3. encryption: ...
```

Build each prompt from the word, so the loop body is the same for every word.

vocabulary.gloss: a string with values inside curly brackets, like f"Define {word}"
a list of words with their meanings
gives you a number with each item when you loop over a list

starterCode:
words = ["variable", "server", "encryption"]

# For each word, ask the AI for a one-sentence definition
# and print it as:  1. variable: ...

tests.name: prints three numbered lines with the three words

hints: for word in words: — inside the loop, build the prompt with an f-string: f"Define the word {word} in one simple sentence."
You need a number for each line. Start with number = 1 before the loop and add 1 at the end of each turn, or use for number, word in enumerate(words, start=1).
Print with an f-string too: print(f"{number}. {word}: {definition}")
solution:
words = ["variable", "server", "encryption"]

for number, word in enumerate(words, start=1):
    definition = call_gpt(f"Define the word {word} in one simple sentence, for a beginner.")
    print(f"{number}. {word}: {definition}")
